name: hook
narration: Attention starts with one line of math. Here is how it works.
caption: one line

name: vectors
narration: Each token becomes a query, a key, and a value, using three learned projections.
caption: Q · K · V

name: scores
narration: Dot products compare each query with every key.
caption: compare tokens

name: softmax
narration: Divide by the square root of the key dimension, then apply softmax.
caption: weights sum to 1

name: mix
narration: The weights blend the values into a new vector for each token.
caption: weighted sum

name: context
narration: Transformers add feed-forward layers and residual paths.
caption: one part of a transformer
